```lean
Submodule.span_induction.{u_1, u_4} {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] {x : M}
  {s : Set M} {p : M → Prop} (h : x ∈ Submodule.span R s) (mem : ∀ x ∈ s, p x) (zero : p 0)
  (add : ∀ (x y : M), p x → p y → p (x + y)) (smul : ∀ (a : R) (x : M), p x → p (a • x)) : p x
```
***
An induction principle for span membership. If `p` holds for 0 and all elements of `s`, and is
preserved under addition and scalar multiplication, then `p` holds for all elements of the span of
`s`.
